1 Werkstudent:in Sales (m/w/d) Why This Role ExistsRight now the founders + the Founders Associate make the cold calls themselves. That works, but it does not scale.Since we see positive response rates from our current outreach efforts, we are now building a proper outbound motion, and you're the person who runs the front of it. Not "support sales". You dial, you book, you own the number.The upside for you: cold calling is a skill you can only learn by volume. Doing it +200 times a week for six months will teach you more about business than any course you could sign up for.Your RoleWeek 1 to 4: Get on the phone * Shadow the founders on live calls, then take over your own call blocks * Learn the pitch, the finance language and the three objections that come up every single time * 60 to 80 dials per call block, roughly 200 per week * Book your first qualified meetingMonth 2 to 3: Own your pipeline * Build and clean your own target lists (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay) * Research accounts before you dial, so the opener actually lands (or automate it) * Handle the full top of funnel: dial, qualify, book, hand over * Keep the CRM clean enough that we can actually read itMonth 4 and beyond: Build the machine * Test openers, lists and follow-up sequences, and tell us what works * Turn what works into a playbook the next hire can use * Grow into full-cycle sales, sit in on discovery and demo calls, take your own dealsWhat You Need to BringNon-negotiables: * German really well, solid English. Austrian and German CFOs will not do a discovery call in English. * You are not scared of the phone. Ten rejections in a row annoy you, they don't break you. * We don't care what you studied, or whether you studied at all. University, gap year, or straight out of HAK all work. How you talk matters more than what's on your certificate. * 20 h/week, on site in Vienna. Cold calling is a team sport and you learn it fastest sitting next to someone who's already good at it. * High agency. You see what needs to happen and make it happen.Strong plus: * Any job where you've had to talk to strangers and sell something: promotion, fundraising, retail, call center, student org * Finance or accounting background, or genuine curiosity about how a controlling team actually works * You've used Apollo, HubSpot, Attio, lemlist or similar before * You use the latest AI tools to automate annoying manual work and follow-upsWhat You'll GetCompensation: * 20 h/week to start. If it works for both sides, more hours or a full-time contract are possible later. * You earn the same whether the week went well or badly. In your first months you should be learning to call properly, not chasing a number to make rent * Minimum salary: €2,236 gross per month (full-time, 38.5 h/week, paid 14 times a year) according to the Austrian collective agreement, with overpayment based on qualifications and experience.Learning: * Direct coaching from founders who've sold to enterprise CFOs and built B2B companies before * Weekly call reviews on your own recordings. This is where the actual learning happens. * You'll speak with C-level executives at companies with 100 to 5,000 employees, in your first month * You learn the full outbound stack: ICP, list building, enrichment, sequencing, calling, qualificationGrowth: * Clear path from top-of-funnel to full-cycle sales, at the speed you earn it * First in line for the first full-time sales role as we scale * A skill set that makes you employable at any startup in Europe, or lets you build your ownHow to ApplySend an email to founders@northscope.at and include one short paragraph: * Why you want to spend 20 hours a week calling strangers about accounting softwareNo CV needed for the first step.
